name: Campfire Tales
source:
Hear a campfire story from grandma Elaine.
You can choose one of three stories: a ghost story, a dragon story or a garlic bread story. Which story you will hear is up to you.

[From [url=https://windysilver.itch.io/campfire-tales]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
听伊莱恩奶奶在篝火旁讲故事。
你可以从三个故事中选择，鬼故事、龙的故事，或蒜香面包的故事。会听到哪一个，由你决定。

[摘自[url=https://windysilver.itch.io/campfire-tales]Itch.io[/url]]
